newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - April 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - April 30.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on April 30. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

President Suharto's youngest son Hutomo Mandala Putra, popularly known as Tommy, will marry a descendant of Javanese royalty today in the Jakarta Beautiful Indonesia in a Miniature theme park founded by his late mother.

One supporter of the Moslem-oriented United Development Party (PPP) was killed yesterday in Pasuruan, East Java. The man was hit by a bus while participating in a PPP convoy on his motorbike. Meanwhile in Jakarta, thousands of PPP supporters violated campaign rules against parades by pouring into the streets with motorcycles, trucks, buses and vans.

The Consortium of Private Domestic Banks said a number of private banks want to participate in lending $1.2 billion to a firm controlled by President Suharto's youngest son Hutomo Mandala Putra which has been given special priveleges to produce a national car with KIA motors of South Korea.

The Surabaya chapter of the Christian-Nationalist Indonesian Democratic Party (PDI) has stopped campaigning activities in Surabaya. The decission came after PDI supporters of the ousted leader of the PDI, Megawati Sukarnoputri, clashed with supporters of the government-backed PDI leader Surjadi in Surabaya on Monday.
